symptom: resultMatchesProtocol returns true when result.metricFamily is absent from evaluationProtocol.metricFamilies, as long as stage, ID/digest, comparison mode and odds basis match.
lesson: A result can be structurally valid yet use a metric family not authorized by its frozen evaluation protocol. Protocol matching must enforce metric-family membership as well as digest, stage, comparison mode and odds basis.
guardrail: In resultMatchesProtocol, require protocol.metricFamilies.includes(result.metricFamily). Add a fixture where the protocol permits ROI only and a result declares LOGLOSS; it must return false. Keep research-only and do not infer evaluation or production readiness.
